description: Computes solar azimuth/elevation at a clicked point and time for Earth or Mars and draws sun and shadow directions.

descriptionFull.title: Click a point on the map to compute the sun's azimuth and elevation at the mission time (or any time via a slider). Supports Earth (NOAA approximation) and Mars (Allison & McEwen 2000). Draws sun-direction and shadow-direction lines on the map.

example.body: EARTH || MARS (optional; auto-detected from mission radius)

name: SolarIllumination

components.name: Planetary Body
components.description: Override the auto-detected body (from mission radius).
